$comment: The far ecology (docs/ECOLOGY.md, WORK_QUEUE item 11): away from players the deer and wolves are data only, one record per herd or pack (its place on the face's island, size, hunger and energy averages, state), stepped over whole days by crates/dwell-ecology. `island`: the coarse grid the ecology runs on (`cellM` m a cell, sampled from the face's world map) and the longest step (`stepDays`): a big fast-forward is cut into steps of at most this. `grazing`: the forage per cell in deer-days (one unit feeds one head for a day), the most a cell holds by its ground (the first of `grounds` whose `maxHeightM` and `maxSlopeDeg` it is under; sea and lakes hold none and are not walked), and its `refuge` (optional, 0 to 1: the share of a herd on it hunters can't take: steep crags), regrowing toward it at `regrowPerDay` of the gap a day; the real tall grass is not touched (a later slice applies it near players). A species: its group's `dieBelow` (a group under it is gone: there is no floor; groups and species can die out, resisted by the system: prey hard to find when scarce, refuges, fast breeding at low density, hunters leaving when prey is scarce, slow starvation), `cap` (above it a group splits in two), `mergeBelow` and `mergeRadiusM` (small groups near each other join), `maxGroups` on the island; `start` groups and size; `breedPerDay` (growth a day while well fed: hunger under `breedBelowHunger`, slowed as the island fills: deer by the grazing's carrying capacity, predators by their prey per head); `hungerDays` (how fast hunger follows the food: 0 fed, 1 none); starving above `starveAboveHunger` loses up to `starvePerDay` of the group a day (slow); `speedMPerDay`; `senseRadiusM`; `diet` either `graze` (forage per head per day) or `prey` (the species it hunts, its most kills a head a day falling off as N²/(N²+h²) of the prey head N it can find in its sense outside refuges, h = `halfSaturationHead` (Holling type III: the last few are hard to find), its need per head per day, prey per head for the island's bound, reach); `flee` (optional: the species it keeps `radiusM` from); `disperse` (optional: above `aboveHunger` the group leaves for the island's biggest prey group at `speedFactor`, members leaving at `leavePerDay`, instead of starving). Prototype tuning (ARCHITECTURE.md §6.1). Run `node shared/ecology/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-ecology/src/ecology.gen.rs is stale. `near` (docs/ECOLOGY.md §8): a herd or pack a player comes within `spawnM` of becomes its individuals (the species' `near.creature`, ADR 0073's creatures) and folds back into its record once no player is within `foldM` of them (the hysteresis); they think every `thinkS`; an individual is placed only on the ecology's ground (its island cell walkable, dry, no steeper than `maxSlopeDeg` to the next column), else on the nearest such column within `searchM` of its record. A species' `near` (optional: without it the species stays a record): the mockup's needs (docs/proposals/ECOSYSTEM_MOCKUP_NOTES.md), hunger (0 fed, 1 none) rising `hungerPerS`, energy (1 rested) falling `energyPerS` awake; `sleep` (below `belowEnergy`, or at night with `nightChancePerS` while hunger is under `nightBelowHunger`; `gainPerS` asleep, waking after `minS` once over `wakeAboveEnergy` or hungrier than `wakeAboveHunger`); a grazer's `graze` (above `aboveHunger` it eats the island cell's forage, `eatPerS` of hunger and `foragePerS` of the cell's forage a second, until under `fullBelow`; `block` (optional) the real block it eats, with `blockChancePerS` a second: the only world change, near players only); a hunter's `hunt` (above `aboveHunger` it chases the nearest prey individual within `senseM` at `sprint` × its walk, kills it within `reachM`, and the kill feeds packmates within `feedsPackM` by `feedsPack` of their hunger); `flee` (from the species' `flee.from` within `radiusM`, at `pace` × its walk); `mate` (both under `belowHunger` and over `aboveEnergy`, a groupmate within `radiusM`, within `reachM` a young with `chance` a try up to the group's `cap`, each parent's hunger + `cost`; a failed try costs `tired` energy); `companyM` (otherwise it keeps to its group within this) and `wanderM`.
